args.title: Fix password reset email link to use correct base URL instead of localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The current password reset email constructs the reset link using PUBLIC_URL environment variable or defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes the password reset link in emails to point to localhost in environments where PUBLIC_URL is unset or wrongly configured, leading to broken links.

This change proposes to fix the base URL usage to ensure the password reset link points to the correct, externally accessible domain, probably by ensuring PUBLIC_URL is set correctly in the environment or by improving configuration management to avoid fallback to localhost in production.
